label: For every omniscient wholly good being, every occurring intense suffering it could prevent has an…
paraphrase: For every omniscient wholly good being, every occurring intense suffering it could prevent has an unavoidable greater-good loss or equal/worse evil cost of prevention. This is a necessary condition only, in Rowe’s published simplified form.

connection_plan.missing_bridge: Through Rowe's core: with refined gratuitous suffering this constraint yields STMT-ROWE-NO-THEISTIC-BEING, whose own plan names the remaining bearer bridge (IsGod g gives Omniscient, Omnipotent and WhollyGood of g on a carrier shared with Rowe's signature). The constraint itself now has a conditional support option: WHOLLY_GOOD_1 with the open outcome bridge (outcomeSenseYieldsPermissionConstraint).
connection_plan.blocker: The bearer bridge of STMT-ROWE-NO-THEISTIC-BEING is unbuilt (issue #1735). Which sense of WhollyGood the case's GOD_4 bearer has is unwarranted: WHOLLY_GOOD_2 yields only a constraint-qualified condition and WHOLLY_GOOD_3 yields neither (trolley goodness-sense controls); divine permission versus intention is owned by issue #1456.
